name: QBF Arena (SAT'03 QBF Evaluation)
description: An evaluation suite and competition-style assessment measuring the performance of QBF solvers on a collection of benchmark quantified Boolean formula instances from the SAT'03 evaluation.
evaluation_method: instances_solved_within_time_limit (solve count) and runtime; penalized scoring for wrong answers/timeouts
general_score_metric: number_of_instances_solved (solve rate) often combined with total CPU time or PAR‑2 style runtime metric
notes: Classic non‑LLM solver benchmark; dataset age means some modern solvers may saturate portions of the suite and performance comparisons can be affected by solver engineering and hardware; instance distribution biases may exist.
